# INVALID — baseline_v0 run contaminated by missing \\r\\n\\r\\n header terminator

## Status
**DO NOT CITE.** The `results/baseline_v0/` artifacts (live_feed.jsonl, live_decisions_export.csv, side_log.jsonl) were generated by `gen/generate.py`'s `benign_worker` before the HTTP header terminator was fixed in commit `c4b02b7`.

## The bug
The benign POST request header ended with:

```
Content-Type: multipart/form-data\r\n
<body bytes follow immediately>
```

There was no blank line (`\r\n\r\n`) terminating the header. `parse_http()` looks for `\r\n\r\n` to set `header_complete=1`, so **every benign flow had `header_complete=0`**, identical to slowloris attacks. This made the old model trivially flag all benign flows as attacks, inflating the benign false-positive rate to ~67% and collapsing any meaningful per-attack recall.

## The fix
Commit `c4b02b7` ("Fix HTTP header termination in benign_worker") appends `\r\n\r\n` to the benign header so that `parse_http()` correctly detects `header_complete=1` for benign flows and `header_complete=0` only for genuinely incomplete headers (slowloris).

## Consequence
All numbers derived from `results/baseline_v0/` (including the per-flow baseline numbers in `results/baseline_v0/README.md`) are invalid for any claim about benign false-positive rates or per-attack detection. Do not cite them. Re-derive baseline numbers from a fresh live run with the fixed generator.
